tasks.title: Develop the visual journey
tasks.instructions: Plan a clear sequence of scenes and frames that communicates the intended emotional and visual progression.

criteria.title: Journey continuity
criteria.description: The scene sequence has a legible beginning, progression and resolution; character, place and object details remain continuous across transitions.

criteria.title: Frame composition
criteria.description: Each key frame has a readable subject, intentional composition and framing that supports the scene's purpose.
